name: American Express Gold Rewards Card (Canada)

apr.notes: Preferred annual interest rate 21.99% on purchases and funds advances; higher rates apply after missed payments.

credit_required.notes: Canadian resident with a Canadian credit file.

categories.label: Gas, grocery and drugstore purchases in Canada

rewards.redemption_notes: Membership Rewards points redeem through Use Points for Purchases (1,000 points = $10 on eligible purchases), travel, gift cards and 1:1 transfers to partner loyalty programs.

signup_bonus.description: 5,000 Membership Rewards points for each monthly billing period with $1,000 in spend during the first year (up to 60,000 points).

benefits.title: $100 Annual Travel Credit
benefits.description: $100 CAD annual travel credit on a single travel booking of $100 or more.

benefits.title: NEXUS statement credit
benefits.description: $50 CAD statement credit for a NEXUS application or renewal fee.

notes: American Express Canada cards have no network package tier, so network_tier is none.
